propositions: Jira workflows may forbid direct end-state transitions (e.g. open→done when only open→in_progress→done is allowed), causing outbound sync to fail and tickets to drift.
The direct transition path in transition_issue_by_name raises RuntimeError (Cloud) or ValueError/IllegalTransitionError (DC) when no single hop reaches the target status.

Replay fallback reconstructs the recorded sequence of intermediate status hops from append-only STATUS events, forward-mapped to Jira names, and executes them in order via successive transition_issue_by_name calls.

Resume point is determined by matching the current Jira issue status (from get_issue) directly against the recorded hop sequence in Jira name-space, anchoring on the last positional match to avoid non-injective inverse mapping.
Replay aborts if any hop raises RuntimeError, ValueError, IllegalTransitionError, or HTTPError/BackendHTTPError, falling through to comment-fallback and drift (result=None).
local_id parameter is added to _update_one_scalar_update to enable lookup of recorded status hops; falsy local_id skips replay and behaves as today.
